tip: English 'left it at home' is two verbs in Korean: 놓고 왔어요 (noko wasseoyo) = put it down and came. You say both the placing – 놓다 (nota) – and the coming – 오다 (oda).
찍을까요? (jjigeulkkayo?) – the -(으)ㄹ까요 ending means 'shall we?'. Korean has no separate word for 'shall'; the whole suggestion lives in the verb ending.
